name: RRVerb-10
description: Digital reverb emulation of an 80s Micro Rack unit (BOS-007 gate array)
author: Schwung RRVerb-10 port; chip emulation by Sergey V. Mikayev (MUNT), ROM research by giulioz

assets.label: ROM
assets.description: Requires the unit's 16 KB program ROM
assets.hint: Dump of the MSM27C128 EPROM (v1.0.1). Not redistributable - supply your own.

ui_hierarchy._comment: MUST stay in sync with the ui_hierarchy served by get_param() in rrverb10.cpp -- neither one is authoritative everywhere. A chain slot (fx1-4) reads THIS copy first; the Master FX bus and send slots read the PLUGIN. Drift shows a different module on each surface, silently. tests/hierarchy.test.mjs asserts they agree.

params.name: Mode
params._short_comment: The grid draws an enum as a two-line 3-char square; without these, M-Tap 1 and M-Tap 2 render as the same cell.
